payload.title: UI: filtros en Reviews (team/proyecto/agente/edad)
payload.description:
## Origen

PRB-212 agregó filtros GraphQL; la cola `#/reviews` no los expone.

## Criterios

- Controles en ReviewsView para teamId, projectId, reviewerId, olderThanDays, openOnly
- La query usa esos filtros

payload.body: Controles en ReviewsView: openOnly, team, project, reviewer, olderThanDays.
